script.why: late night, moon up, wet pavement

scenes.name: The EX in the crowd
scenes.what: Leaving the club amid fawning crowds, the POET glimpses the EX from behind and reaches for him but cannot get through.
scenes.camera: handheld follow through the crowd; EX kept back-to-camera, soft focus, reaching hand in foreground
scenes.here: the sidewalk at the foot of the spire
scenes.block: handheld follow through the crowd; the EX's back, soft

scenes.name: Walking toward the moon
scenes.what: POET and EX walk down the Atlantis street together, talking, the moon at the end of the street; they 'grow old together' in feeling only (aging not literal).
lines: the way we used to see it
scenes.camera: long tracking two-shot from behind (EX's face never shown), moon framed at the vanishing point; insert of both reflections in a puddle
scenes.position: along the street, heading toward the moon
scenes.block: long tracking two-shot from behind, the moon at the vanishing point; the canopy dark at this hour; puddle insert (62)

scenes.name: Suitcases at the phone booth
scenes.what: EX and POET stand on the sidewalk near the phone booth with suitcases at their feet; the EX helps him pack to go.
scenes.camera: low shot at suitcase level, booth light spilling on the curb; EX present only as hands and back
scenes.block: low at suitcase level, the booth's light on the curb (100)

scenes.name: The call to Mother
scenes.what: POET enters the booth and calls his MOTHER; they talk while watching the POET and EX break up on the sidewalk; cut to POET and MOTHER in her living room, the break-up still in the background. He hangs up and she disappears.
scenes.camera: through the booth glass with the break-up on the sidewalk behind; in the living room, a window frame holding the sidewalk scene (window inferred)
scenes.position: inside the phone booth, then mother's living room (Baltimere home)
scenes.here: inside the booth (by phone: the mother's living room, the Overseer)
scenes.block: through the booth glass, the break-up behind; then her window holds the sidewalk

scenes.name: Father and son to the inner harbor
scenes.what: POET calls his FATHER, who appears from the yonders and watches the break-up; they walk paths east toward the sunrise and stroll the inner harbor, the break-up continuing in the background.
scenes.camera: wide walking shot along pier lights from behind, dawn ahead; break-up layered in the background plate
scenes.position: paths running east from the booth to the harbor promenade and piers
scenes.here: by phone: the Inner Harbour before dawn
scenes.block: wide walking shot along the pier lights from behind, dawn ahead; the break-up in the background plate

scenes.name: The EX turns to haze
scenes.what: POET and EX are back on the sidewalk; the EX turns to haze and disappears, leaving the POET alone.
scenes.camera: locked-off wide two-shot; the EX dissolves out, hold on the POET alone at the curb
scenes.block: locked-off two-shot; the EX dissolves; hold on him alone

foundry.desc: EX and POET stand on a sidewalk beside a phone booth, suitcases at their feet.
POET and MOTHER engage in conversation while observing POET and EX's breakup unfolding in the background on the sidewalk.
Literal visual match: POET seated on brick roof ledge watching massive plumes of white exhaust steam rise.
foundry.line: Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she's never known.
